title: WorkWink Apply input
description: Prepare one approved WorkWink application. PREPARE is the safe default and never clicks the final submit button.

applicationId.title: Application ID
applicationId.description: Opaque WorkWink application identifier. No resume or applicant PII is placed in Actor input.

workwinkApiBaseUrl.title: WorkWink API base URL
workwinkApiBaseUrl.description: HTTPS WorkWink API that exchanges the short-lived dispatch token for a single application lease.

mode.title: Run mode
mode.description: PREPARE fills supported fields and stops. SUBMIT additionally requires a per-application approval token and server authorization.

dispatchToken.title: Short-lived dispatch token
dispatchToken.description: Single-use WorkWink token scoped to this application. Stored encrypted by Apify.

approvalToken.title: Per-application submit approval
approvalToken.description: Required only for SUBMIT. It must be minted after the user approves this exact application package.

captureAuditScreenshot.title: Capture audit screenshot
captureAuditScreenshot.description: Opt in to storing a private screenshot in the run key-value store. It can contain applicant data.

navigationTimeoutSecs.title: Navigation timeout (seconds)
navigationTimeoutSecs.description: Maximum time for page navigation and form interactions.
